svg.title: Every gate at each line (charter 0.4.19)
svg.desc: A matrix of thirteen gates against the three lines a change crosses: the session, the commit and the merge, with the override that gets past each refusal.
svg.text: Every gate, at each line a change crosses
charter 0.4.19 · the same engine (package/.charter/checks.py) runs at all three; each line catches what the one before can miss
THE WAY PAST A REFUSAL (THE OVERRIDE)

g.title: Scope: Write a change request; the owner approves it
g.text: Write a change request; the owner approves it

g.title: Rails: Name an open rail item; the owner adds items
g.text: Name an open rail item; the owner adds items

g.title: Size: frozen file: Move code out; or the owner opens a split unit or names an exception
g.text: Move code out; or the owner opens a split unit or names an

g.title: Done needs evidence: Check the boxes and cite a commit or a $ command; or keep it open
g.text: Check the boxes and cite a commit or a $ command; or keep

g.title: Probes run again: Make the probe pass; one that passed before the work is refused with probes.base_must_fail
g.text: Make the probe pass; one that passed before the work is

g.title: Decisions: Propose a successor decision; the owner retires the old one
g.text: Propose a successor decision; the owner retires the old

g.title: Perimeter: Add - path: why under ## Outside perimeter
g.text: Add - path: why under ## Outside perimeter

g.title: Owner-only changes: Leave it staged, run charter handover; the owner commits
g.text: Leave it staged, run charter handover; the owner commits

g.title: Config readable: The owner corrects charter/config.json
Memory: Give the decision a ## Because and a later expires:
g.text: Give the decision a ## Because and a later expires:

g.title: Completion claim: Cite a commit, a path:line or a $ command, or say what is not done
g.text: Cite a commit, a path:line or a $ command, or say what is

g.title: Anchored deliverables: Anchor each claim, or mark it reported or inference
g.text: Anchor each claim, or mark it reported or inference

g.title: Chain budget: Write the handoff and run charter chain next
g.text: Write the handoff and run charter chain next

svg.text: refuses under the condition named (a track, an opt-in, a chain session)
warns, and logs to the gate log
Every gate fails open on its own errors and logs them; a config the gates cannot read is refused instead. Sources: docs/gates.md § The gates, § Git hook, § CI, § Config.
